label: kizuna_friend_a_02
text: Man, you sure did give me a beating in that\nAcademy Ace Tournament![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_03
text: Seems like all my closest buddies are in another\nleague, you know?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_04
text: I mean, look at you—you just up and became\na Champion! In your first year, to boot!\c\nYou know that’s pretty amazing, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_05
text: Then there’s Nemona—top marks in every class\nat school, and she’s Champion-ranked too.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_06
text: And I hear Penny’s got some kind of offer to\nwork for the Pokémon League or something?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_07
text: I seem to be the only average one around here.\nNothing special about me...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_08a
text: Nah, I mean...it’s just, like, a hobby really.\c\nI only learned how to do the basics because my\n[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad wasn’t around to cook for me...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_08b
text: Tch! You sure don’t give a guy a break, huh?\c\nSo, the only special thing about me is who my\n[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad was? Not like I had anything to do with it...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_10
text: See, now that Mabosstiff is doing so much better,\nand since the Treasure Hunt is still going and all,\r\nI’ve been thinking of a new goal: to find myself![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_11
text: And I guess you’ve really gotta start by knowing\nwhere you come from, which means...I should\r\nlearn more about my [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_12a
text: She was a student at this school once, too. That’s\nwhat I heard.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_12b
text: He was a student at this school once, too. That’s\nwhat I heard.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_13a
text: I’m gonna search the whole school for info about\nwhat kind of person she really was![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_13b
text: I’m gonna search the whole school for info about\nwhat kind of person he really was![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: kizuna_friend_a_14
text: Thanks for the inspiration, little buddy![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
